script:
control-agent-server conversation send "$I" --text 'QA_F11 plain run'
control-agent-server conversation wait "$I" --until running --timeout 30
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$I/goal" --json '{"objective": "QA_F11 refused objective", "max_iterations": 1}' --expect 409 --check detail eq 'Conversation run or goal loop already running.' --save F11.goal-busy-run/goal
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$I/goal/resume" --expect 409 --check detail eq 'Conversation run or goal loop already running.' --save F11.goal-busy-run/resume
control-agent-server conversation events "$I" --key goal --expect-count 2
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$I/interrupt" --expect 200
control-agent-server conversation wait "$I" --until paused --timeout 30
